rationale: Recent recurrence curricula regressed, but anchor-refresh and recurrent-tail float rescue remain the best live categories. This keeps the reverse-tail family intact while making one compact structural change to the recurrent pass: the decoder-output anchor now refreshes slightly after each recurrent block instead of staying frozen. In parallel, the fp16 export budget is reallocated from recurrent-tail Q/K toward V-path preservation, keeping the last K as a stabilizer. The hypothesis is better late-tail state reuse plus export sensitivity on the value path, without broad shape or optimizer churn.
title: Anchor-Refresh Reverse Tail + V-Path FP16 Swap
